challenges.title: Evil Twin Wi-Fi
challenges.subtitle: Network Defense
challenges.briefing: Cybercriminals set up fake wireless access points with names almost identical to legitimate public networks to intercept your unencrypted internet traffic. Can you identify the secure connection from the rogue impostor?
challenges.scenario: You are sitting in the Central City Public Library with your laptop. You open your Wi-Fi settings to connect to the internet. Four networks appear nearby.

networks.reason: This is the legitimate network. It uses modern WPA3 encryption, strong signal, and is authenticated with an official government digital certificate.

networks.captivePortal: Unsigned plain HTTP login page requesting email & social login
networks.reason: This is an Evil Twin honeypot. It has no encryption, uses an all-caps misleading SSID, and hosts an unencrypted credential-harvesting captive portal.
Completely unsecured open network from an unknown origin. Any eavesdropper within range can sniff unencrypted traffic.
Legitimate but restricted to authorized staff. Students should not attempt unauthorized access to employee networks.

challenges.title: QR Code Trap
challenges.subtitle: Quishing Defense
challenges.briefing: Attackers paste fake QR code stickers over real physical posters and meters to redirect users to malicious websites ('Quishing'). Use your digital inspector to analyze the embedded link before opening!

posters.title: City Bike Rental Station
posters.visual: A physical bicycle dock with a QR code sticker that appears slightly peeling and misaligned.
posters.explanation: Malicious sticker placed over the real bike terminal. The URL uses unencrypted HTTP and a suspicious '.info' checkout domain designed to steal payment cards.

posters.title: Museum Interactive Guide
posters.visual: A professionally printed brass plaque inside the modern art gallery with an etched QR code.
posters.explanation: Legitimate QR code etched directly onto the museum fixture, leading to the official museum HTTPS domain.

posters.title: School Science Fair Schedule
posters.visual: A bulletin board flyer with an updated paper QR code taped over the original schedule.
posters.explanation: A malicious prank/trap taped over school notices. The shortened link points to a known gaming credential phishing scam.

posters.title: Transit Bus Arrival Times
posters.visual: A digital transit screen displaying a dynamically generated QR code for live bus tracking.
posters.explanation: Authentic dynamic QR code displayed on an authorized government transit terminal, pointing to the official citygov.us portal.

challenges.title: App Permissions
challenges.subtitle: Mobile Security
challenges.briefing: Mobile apps frequently demand excessive permissions that harvest private contacts, location, and recordings. Configure the permission toggles to uphold the Principle of Least Privilege!

permissions.label: Camera / Flash LED
permissions.tip: Needed to physically control the camera LED hardware.

permissions.label: Microphone Audio Recording
permissions.tip: Flashlights never need to listen to your voice or surroundings.

permissions.label: Precise GPS Location
permissions.tip: Excessive tracking used for advertising broker sales.

permissions.label: Location While Using App
permissions.tip: Essential to calculate directions from where you are.

permissions.label: Storage Access (Offline Maps)
permissions.tip: Saves offline transit maps to device memory.

permissions.label: Read All SMS Text Messages
permissions.tip: Maps have zero reason to inspect private text messages.

permissions.label: Camera Access
permissions.tip: Not needed for standard transit routing.

challenges.title: Oversharing / Privacy
challenges.subtitle: Digital Footprint
challenges.briefing: Everything shared publicly becomes part of your permanent digital footprint. Attackers piece together clues from casual posts for identity theft and social engineering. Flag each post as Safe or Risky!

posts.author: Alex_Gamer99
posts.content: Excited for vacation! Flying to London on Flight BA219, here is my boarding pass! ✈️ (Full barcode & passport name visible)
posts.explanation: Boarding pass barcodes store your frequent flyer number, passport details, and passenger record locator, allowing anyone to modify your flight or steal identity data.

posts.author: Alex_Gamer99
posts.content: Finished my digital painting in art class today! What do you guys think? 🎨
posts.explanation: Safe to share! Creative artwork without personal identifiers, locations, or sensitive metadata.

posts.author: Alex_Gamer99
posts.content: Happy 10th Birthday to my favorite golden retriever, Barnaby! He has been my best buddy since elementary school! 🐕
posts.explanation: First pet's name is the most common security recovery question on online accounts. Revealing pet names publicly gives attackers answers to password resets.

posts.author: Alex_Gamer99
posts.content: Parents are away in Chicago for the whole weekend, house all to myself! Party time! 🏠🎉
posts.explanation: Broadcasting that a home is unoccupied or that you are alone invites physical burglary and targeted stalking.

challenges.title: Caesar Cipher
challenges.subtitle: Cryptography
challenges.briefing: Julius Caesar protected military dispatches by shifting each letter in the alphabet by a fixed secret number. Decode the intercepted adversary communication and transmit the response!
challenges.hint: Each letter in the secret message was shifted forward by 3 positions (D -> A, E -> B, etc.). Rotate backward by 3!
challenges.explanation: You decoded the cipher! Simple shift ciphers are easily broken today using letter frequency analysis, which is why modern computers use 256-bit AES mathematical encryption.

challenges.title: Real or Deepfake
challenges.subtitle: AI Forensics
challenges.briefing: Generative AI can fabricate hyper-realistic human portraits and cloned voices. Inspect visual forensic clues to separate authentic media from AI-generated deepfakes!

items.title: Profile Portrait A
items.description: Student avatar with asymmetrical earrings, blurred iris edge, and background bookshelf with nonsensical warped text.
clues: Nonsensical distorted text on background objects
Irregular pupil reflections from ambient light
items.explanation: AI models struggle with subtle symmetrical physics, resulting in mismatched earrings and distorted background details.

items.title: Profile Portrait B
items.description: Photograph taken with crisp natural lighting, consistent skin pores, correct lens depth-of-field, and realistic eye reflections.
clues: Natural skin texture without artificial plastic blur
Consistent catchlights in both eyes matching room illumination
items.explanation: This is an authentic human portrait. Note the natural skin texture and consistent lighting reflections across both eyes.
